Following a major Bay Area real estate expansion in 2025, Apple is once again growing its footprint in Sunnyvale. Here's what happened.

蘋果持續擴展其地產規模

According to the Mercury News (via AppleInsider), Apple has agreed to lease a 125,800-square-foot office building at 580 N. Mary Ave. in Sunnyvale.

這宗交易是蘋果於2026年在該區首次錄得的大型房地產動作。在2025年，該公司斥資逾10億美元擴大其於南灣區的據點。

That expansion included purchasing the Cupertino Gateway complex, a three-building property, for $166.9 million; the Mathilda Commons campus, a two-building property in Sunnyvale, for $350 million; and the Mathilda Campus, an adjacent four-building property, for $365 million.

蘋果其後再斥資2億1600萬美元，購入位於庫比蒂諾史蒂文斯克雷克大道上的兩幢大樓，使其於2025年公布的灣區擴張計劃合共涉及逾150萬平方呎的辦公及實驗室空間。

The latest lease comes as office leasing activity in the South Bay begins to pick back up, the Mercury News said, with vacancy rates improving from both the prior quarter and a year ago:

據高力國際（Colliers）報告，南灣區2026年第二季的辦公室空置率為14.1%。高力國際將該市場範圍界定為聖克拉拉縣及費利蒙。

Besides Apple, the report noted that Amazon has also agreed to lease 316,600 square feet of office space at 1000 Enterprise Way in Sunnyvale.

如欲閱讀《水星新聞報》完整報導，請按此連結。
